text:
In his casa of campo, that is sencilla and pequeña,
veo to the jíbaro our. Triste is, as his casa.
Gris, cae sobre his frente, that is rugosa, the greña.
his cuerpo is amarillo, of escasísima grasa.


Enfrente of the casa brilla a fuego of leña;
and, to the calor of the brasa, plátano verde asa.
Mísero and dolorido, with it más puro él sueña.
the is a gran form of the más pobre masa.


Amante of the terruño, with the terruño muere.
To a bienestar sin honra, pobreza honrosa quiere.
his hierro, that is templado, dice of his bravura.


his lengua is rural, but muy abundante in tinos.
Barro dan a their plantas the peores caminos.
and is his deleite único the amarga mascadura.

translation.title: the Jíbaro
